title.zh: 缩放点积与多头注意力

en.a: Treat attention as a normalized, data-dependent linear map whose causal mask preserves the autoregressive factorization.
en.b: Derive the scale, every backward matrix, masking equivalence, and the multi-head cost/path-length trade-off.

zh.a: 将注意力视为一种归一化的、数据依赖的线性映射，其因果掩码保留了自回归分解。
zh.b: 推导缩放因子、每个反向传播矩阵、掩码等价性以及多头机制的成本与路径长度权衡。
